name: Jane Doe
text: The separate AP and AR queues make it much easier to identify which invoices still require action. The stage-aging information would be especially useful during month-end.

name: Michael Torres
text: The invoice detail view clearly shows what my department needs to approve. A notification for invoices held more than five days would make the workflow even stronger.

name: Priya Raman
text: Reconciling QuickBooks to Infinium used to take most of a day. The exact-to-the-cent matching and the exceptions list save real time at close.

name: Sam Whitfield
text: Useful, but I would like to export the preview tables straight from the page instead of waiting for the workbook.

name: Alicia Moreno
text: The sales tax cleanup flags new vendors clearly, and the control check gives me confidence nothing was dropped.
